newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Banco Mercantil to join units.
newsitem.headline: Banco Mercantil to join units.

text.p: Venezuela's second largest bank, Banco Mercantil, said Tuesday it was to propose combining its various units into one bank at a shareholders meeting on Sept 26.

"The plan contemplates the fusion through the absorption by Banco Mercantil of the companies Banco Inversion de Mercantil, Banco Hipotecario Mercantil, Arrendadora Mercantil and Fondo Mercantil, which are currently independent companies," the bank said in a release.
At the end of July Banco Mercantil was the second biggest in terms of deposits 428 billion ($900 million).
The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission last week approved Mercantil's application for a level one American Depository Receipt (ADR) program.
